data.name: Kauser
data.gender_notes: Kauser is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who is granted a favour or is blessed. The name Kauser carries the meaning “Grace” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Kauser usually hope their child will grow to embody grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sign of Allah's blessings and mercy
data.etymology: Kauser belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kauser total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: كوسر
in_arabic.meaning: نهر في الجنة، اسم من أسماء النبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم
in_arabic.long_meaning: كوسر هو اسم من أسماء النبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم، ويعني النهر الذي في الجنة والذي ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم، ويعتبر من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني روحانية ودلالات دينية عميقة في الإسلام

in_urdu.name: کوسر
in_urdu.meaning: جنت کا ایک دریا، نبی محمد صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کا ایک نام
in_urdu.long_meaning: کوسر نام نبی محمد صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کے ناموں میں سے ایک ہے، اور یہ جنت میں ایک دریا کا نام ہے جو قرآن کریم میں ذکر کیا گیا ہے، یہ نام اسلامی تقالید میں روحانی اور مذہبی اہمیت رکھتا ہے

in_hindi.name: कौसर
in_hindi.meaning: स्वर्ग में एक नदी, पैगंबर मुहम्मद का एक नाम
in_hindi.long_meaning: कौसर नाम पैगंबर मुहम्मद के नामों में से एक है, और यह स्वर्ग में एक नदी का नाम है जिसका उल्लेख कुरआन में किया गया है, यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम परंपरा में आध्यात्मिक और धार्मिक महत्व रखता है

in_pashto.name: کوسر
in_pashto.meaning: په جنت کې يو سيند، د پيغمبر محمد صلی الله عليه وسلم يو نوم
in_pashto.long_meaning: کوسر د پيغمبر محمد صلی الله عليه وسلم د نومو څخه يو دی، او دا په جنت کې د يو سيند نوم دی چې په قرآن کريم کې يې ذکر دی، دا نوم په افغان او پښتني مسلم دود کې روحاني او مذهبي اهميت لري

in_english.name: Kauser
in_english.meaning: A river in Paradise, one of the names of the Prophet Muhammad
in_english.long_meaning: Kauser is derived from the Arabic root 'Kawthar', which refers to a river in Paradise mentioned in the Quran (Surah Al-Kawthar). It is also one of the names of the Prophet Muhammad. The name symbolizes spiritual abundance, divine blessings, and is associated with positive personality traits such as generosity and compassion. It is commonly used across Muslim cultures, reflecting its significance in Islamic tradition and heritage

data.cultural_impact: The name Kauser is of Arabic and Persian origin and means "a person who is granted a favour or is blessed." In Islamic culture, this name holds a positive connotation and is often given to children born into families that consider themselves to be particularly fortunate or blessed.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Kauser implies a deep sense of gratitude and appreciation for the blessings bestowed upon an individual. It serves as a reminder of the divine grace and mercy that shapes our lives and encourages those who bear this name to be mindful of the blessings they have received and to strive to spread kindness and generosity towards others. The name Kauser also carries an implicit reminder of the transient nature of life and the importance of cherishing and making the most of our blessings.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Grace" symbolizes A person who is granted a favour or is blessed. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Kauser serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of grace.
